name: emil-kowalski
description: Personal Codex bundle of Emil Kowalski's 13 official design and animation skills.

author.name: Personal bundle; upstream skills by Emil Kowalski

interface.shortDescription: Design interfaces and animations with 13 official skills.
interface.longDescription: A personal Codex wrapper around the skills with compatible Codex invocation metadata from emilkowalski/skills. Includes design engineering, web and Expo animation, motion review, UI prototyping, Apple design, Swift, mobile web, and Sonner. This is a skills-only plugin; the upstream project does not include an MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use emil-design-eng to improve this interface.
Use animate to build a polished transition.
Use review-animations to review my motion code.
